scope: Proposal merit and bounded prototype design; no bank qualification

source_audit.anchor: Primary source identities, limitations and inspected anchors

final_study_gate: Implement and review exact code; bind data/code and protocol prospectively before final evaluation draws/calls. Preserve pilot exposure and failures.
title: Controlled sequential servicing and censoring
history: Three decision times t=0,1,2. H_t=(X,L_0,A_0,...,L_t); X~N(0,1), L_0=0.4*X+epsilon_0. Previous action before t=0 is zero.

law.reward: R_t=10-2*L_(t+1)^2-A_t+0.5*A_t*X; total reward is sum over t=0..2
law.observation: After action but before next state/reward, C_t~Bernoulli(0.65+0.30*expit(0.3*L_t-0.2*A_t)); dropout is absorbing in observed data. Latent full histories are evaluator-only.
law.censoring_assumption: C independent of next innovation conditional on observed H_t,A_t by construction; stress depends on unobserved next innovation and deliberately violates this.

estimand: V(pi)=E_pi[sum R_t] under interventions on actions, without conditioning on surviving observation; dropout is an observation process, not a treatment outcome.

comparators.learned_policy: Select among thresholds {-0.5,0,0.5,1} by known-law IPW value on an independent training set; freeze selected threshold before evaluation.
estimators: Prefix importance weighting with exact behavior and censoring probabilities
Sequential regression/g-computation with fixed fitted model
Complete-case unweighted comparison as an explicitly biased baseline
comparators.weights: For R_t use product over s<=t of I(A_s=pi(H_s))/p(A_s|H_s) times I(C_s=1)/g(H_s,A_s). Prefixes differ by reward time.

reference: Simulate 100000 independent complete trajectories per fixed candidate policy, with a separate reference seed; report reference Monte Carlo SE. This is a numerical reference with known law, not exact population truth.

budget.resource_limit: 4 GiB and 30 minutes per scenario; every timeout remains in denominator

metrics: Bias/RMSE and intervals for each frozen policy and paired value difference
Effective sample size and maximum prefix weight by t
All-request coverage and availability, with reference-MC uncertainty near interval boundaries labeled ambiguous
Regret relative to the finite candidate set, not the universal optimal policy
decision_rule: Approve only the scoped method/regime that passes predeclared availability, useful-width and calibration criteria after code/pilot review; never generalize to hidden bank actions or arbitrary adaptive policies.
remaining: No final simulation or learned-policy result has been run. Optional mortgage records are not a prerequisite for this generated study.
